exposure: gestational weight gain at 30 weeks of gestation
cohort: 3643 underweight pregnant women (pre-pregnancy body mass index ≤ 18.5 kg/m(2) ) in Japan
finding: In underweight pregnant women, gestational weight gain at 30 weeks of ≤5.7 kg and ≤7.2 kg are associated with preterm birth and SGA rates, respectively.
